name: Eye Break
description:
The 20-20-20 rule on autopilot: every 20 minutes, look at something 20 feet (6 m) away for 20 seconds.

Runs quietly in the background and shows a banner or a fullscreen break when it's time, with a gentle chime. Pause it from the top bar. It restarts after you lock the screen, sleep or log out, and waits while a fullscreen app is open.
